_comment: requirement_id -> documents (Licenses, Permits, Certificates, Other) the entry packet must contain. BASE applies to every shipment. Matching against shipment.documents_on_file is a loose substring match on the part before ', '.
BASE: Bill of lading or air waybill, transport document
ISF 10+2 filing confirmation, ocean shipments only
FDA_PRIOR_NOTICE: FDA Prior Notice confirmation number, PNC, filed before arrival
Foreign manufacturer FDA Food Facility Registration number
FDA_FSVP: FSVP importer name, email and DUNS number
FDA_FACILITY_REG: Foreign manufacturer FDA Food Facility Registration number
NOAA_SIMP: IFTP, International Fisheries Trade Permit number, importer of record
SIMP catch and landing data, filed in the ACE entry at time of entry
SIMP chain-of-custody records, retained two years from entry
CPSC_CPC: Children's Product Certificate, eCPC filed at entry via ACE, 16 CFR 1110 as amended eff. 2026-07-08
Third-party test report, ASTM F963, CPSC-accepted laboratory
EPA_ENGINE_3520_21: EPA Form 3520-21, nonroad engine import declaration
FCC_SDOC: FCC SDoC compliance statement supplied with product, 47 CFR 2.1077, records on request, no CBP filing
DOE_CERT: DOE compliance certification report, Compliance Certification Management System
FDA_CERAMICWARE: Lead and cadmium leach test report, CPG 545.400 and 545.450 action levels, surveillance and DWPE evidence, not an entry certificate
CBP_ADCVD_CHECK: AD/CVD scope memo against active orders, threaded rod A-570-932 and A-570-104/C-570-105, case numbers and cash deposit rate if in scope
FDA_FSVP_SEAFOOD: FSVP importer data or seafood-HACCP exemption affirmation, 21 CFR 1.501(b) and 123.12
